graph.title: LEGO 30161-1 Batmobile
notes: All 45 pieces from the parts list are present: 14 pieces in steps 1-8, then 31 in steps 9-14.

The booklet pictures are small, so I guessed several placements and rests_on links. Treat them as approximate. This applies especially to the grate slopes, the 4287b inverted slopes, the 12825 clip tiles, the 1x2 plates and the fin and canopy pieces.

The pieces were added in this order. Step 1: 4x4 plate. Step 2: two grates. Step 3: yellow 2x6. Step 4: two wheel holders. Step 5: 1x2 plate. Step 6: grey 2x6. Step 7: the front sub-assembly of 1x4 plate, two trans-yellow tiles and curved brick. Step 8: two red round plates after flipping the model. Step 9: wheel arches and clip tiles. Step 10: 1x2 plate and two flames. Step 11: studded arch, corner plates and inverted slopes. Step 12: grey 2x2 plate, grates and a 1x2 plate. Step 13: mudguard, 1x6 tiles and canopy. Step 14: wheels and tyres.
The clip tiles are assumed to clip onto the wheel holders. The wheels are assumed to sit on the wheel-holder axles, and each tyre is assumed to be on its wheel.
The 3022 plate in step 12 is assumed to be the base for the windscreen cheese slopes and tiles, and the 1x2 plates are assumed to be small fillers.
The positions are left null, as instructed.
